mapper.select: SELECT acct_number, acct_name, branch_code, product_code, acct_status, cust_id, opened_date, dormancy_date FROM accounts WHERE acct_number = #{acctNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (acct_number, acct_name, branch_code, product_code, acct_status, cust_id, opened_date, dormancy_date) VALUES (#{a.acctNumber}, #{a.acctName}, #{a.branchCode}, #{a.productCode}, #{a.acctStatus}, #{a.custId}, #{a.openedDate}, #{a.dormancyDate})
mapper.select: SELECT acct_number, acct_name, branch_code, product_code, acct_status, cust_id, opened_date, dormancy_date FROM accounts WHERE cust_id = #{custId} ORDER BY acct_number ASC
